g.title: Sn2.0 [supported] HARA summary recomputed in the capstone (08-05 section 2) uncovered_events = 0 == 0; sg01_asil = D == D (SG-01.asil); sg02_asil = B == B (SG-02.asil); sg01_ftti_ms = 300 == 300 (SG-01.ftti_ms); sg02_ftti_ms = 500 == 500 (SG-02.ftti_ms)
G2.1 [assumed] SG-01 (ASIL D): E/E faults do not cause unintended AEB deceleration from A2.1
A2.1 [assumed] Decision and plausibility channels are sufficiently independent (DFA, 03-02) assumption without supporting evidence
Sn2.1a [supported] ASIL decomposition of SG-01 is permitted by ISO 26262-9 decomposition_sg01 = [B(D), B(D)] in [[C(D), A(D)], [B(D), B(D)], [D(D), QM(D)]] (SG-01.decompositions)
Sn2.1b [supported] Fault-tree check: top event rate below the PMHF target of the SG-01 ASIL fta_top_event_per_h = 8e-10 < 1e-08 (SG-01.pmhf_target_per_h)
Sn2.1c [supported] Fault handling time of every SG-01 mechanism within FTTI fhti_max_sg01_ms = 200 <= 300 (SG-01.ftti_ms)
G2.2 [supported] SG-02 (ASIL B) E/E part: loss of perception is detected within 500 ms all support supported
